subject: [AMBER]  Extending constant pH to additional titratable groups

messages.author: 王金玉
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I  want to parametrize a non-standard residue as titratable ones in Amber16, so I need to add the definition of FMN in titratable_residues.py, however, I have initially added the definition and recompiled amber, why does the cpin file generated with cpinutil.py have no information about FMN? The cpin file and some information of definition has been uploaded to the attachment. Could you please help me point out the problem？
Respects
Wangjy
